geometry.generation_point_rule: Use only start/mid/end wall-contact anchors for first-stage raw generation. true_point is the wall/brush-tip point and position is the right-hand constraint point at the same x/y, shifted toward the body by brush_length_m along -Z.

prompt_segments.label: approach
prompt_segments.text: A person stands still and moves the right hand directly toward the left edge of the outside surface of a small wall patch.

prompt_segments.label: brush
prompt_segments.text: A person stands still and slides the right palm flat on the outside surface of a wall in one short straight horizontal stroke from left to right.

prompt_segments.label: stop
prompt_segments.text: A person stands still, lowers the right hand directly to a neutral resting position beside the right thigh, and stops.

prompt_segments.label: approach
prompt_segments.text: A person stands balanced in place in front of a small wall patch, keeps the left arm relaxed by the side, and moves the right hand directly toward the left edge of the wall patch.

prompt_segments.label: brush
prompt_segments.text: A person keeps the left arm relaxed by the side while the right hand brushes one short straight horizontal stroke from left to right on a wall.

prompt_segments.label: stop
prompt_segments.text: A person keeps the left arm relaxed by the side, lowers the right hand directly to a neutral resting position beside the right thigh, and stops.

prompt_segments.label: approach
prompt_segments.text: A person stands in an upright stance in front of a wall and moves the right hand directly toward the left edge of a small wall patch.

prompt_segments.label: brush
prompt_segments.text: A person standing in an upright stance leans forward slightly and moves the right hand across the wall from left to right in one short horizontal stroke.

prompt_segments.label: stop
prompt_segments.text: A person returns to an upright stance, lowers the right hand directly to a neutral resting position beside the right thigh, and stops.
